gommone.waterline_note: y=0 is the static waterline, set at about the lower edge of the tubes (hull keel line 0.20 m below it, V-hull; hull panels are mostly hidden under the tubes). Estimated, not from a boot stripe.

open.waterline_note: y=0 estimated at ~33% of hull depth above the keel line (keel 0.59 m below y=0); boot band +-6 cm around it. T-top is kept as deco_hardtop (gelcoat), not a zone.

cabinato.waterline_note: y=0 estimated at ~31% of hull depth above the keel line (keel 0.53 m below y=0, cockpit sole just above y=0); boot band +-6 cm.

flybridge.waterline_note: y=0 estimated at ~30% of hull depth above the keel line (keel 0.81 m below y=0) near the colour change of the original paint; boot band +-7 cm. Twin screws: node 'propeller' holds both props, shafts and struts.

vela.waterline_note: y=0 set at the original antifouling/boot-stripe colour change (hull bottom 0.74 m below y=0, fin keel bottom 1.25 m below = draft). Boot band +-7 cm. Fin keel split from the bottom; sails deleted, mast, boom and rigging kept as deco_ nodes (mast top 15.7 m).
